sentry.description: Sentry MCP server for AI-powered debugging and error analysis

setup_instructions.3: Set environment variables in your .env.local file
setup_instructions.4: Add this configuration to Cursor → Settings → MCP
setup_instructions.6: Test with: Ask Cursor to 'Show me recent errors from Sentry'

cursor_commands.error_trends: @sentry show error trends for the last 24 hours
cursor_commands.user_impact: @sentry show user impact for recent issues
cursor_commands.ai_generation_errors: @sentry show errors related to AI generation

hashtag_generation_issues.query: @sentry show errors in hashtag generation with AI context
hashtag_generation_issues.context: Include prompt templates, model responses, and user feedback

image_generation_failures.query: @sentry investigate image generation timeouts and failures
image_generation_failures.context: Include Stability AI response codes and generation parameters

audio_generation_problems.query: @sentry analyze audio generation errors and quota limits
audio_generation_problems.context: Include ElevenLabs API responses and voice model usage

supabase_performance.query: @sentry show slow database queries and connection issues
supabase_performance.context: Include query performance metrics and row counts

authentication_issues.query: @sentry investigate user authentication and session problems
authentication_issues.context: Include Supabase auth errors and user flow breakdowns
